title: RFC 3977 conformance: LIST ACTIVE, GROUP, ARTICLE, HEAD, BODY, STAT
description:
Seed the reader with a known corpus of 50 articles across 3 groups. Test: LIST ACTIVE (verify all 3 groups, correct high/low), GROUP (verify article count), ARTICLE by number and by message-ID, HEAD, BODY, STAT. Verify response codes and payload correctness. Artifact: tests/conformance/fetch_commands.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- LIST ACTIVE lists all 3 seeded groups with correct high/low
- ARTICLE <n> returns article body matching seeded content
- ARTICLE <msgid> works globally (no group context required)
- HEAD returns only headers; BODY returns only body (no headers)
- STAT returns 223 without body
- All response codes match RFC 3977 tables
